claims.object_mention: synchronizes neurotransmitter release with Ca2+ influx during action potential firing
claims.quote: At neuronal synapses, synaptotagmin-1 (syt1) acts as a Ca2+ sensor that synchronizes neurotransmitter release with Ca2+ influx during action potential firing.
Heterozygous missense mutations in syt1 have recently been associated with a severe but heterogeneous developmental syndrome, termed syt1-associated neurodevelopmental disorder.
Synaptic transmission was impaired in neurons expressing mutant variants, which demonstrated potent, graded dominant-negative effects.
